items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: That was before I went on the road with Lee Allen.

ctx.x: He said, well, what other job you do besides music? I said, well, this is all I do, I got now, the music right now. That's all I do. You don't know how to trust those musicians. You know, that's what he says, you know. I said, well, man, let's, I said, well, let's face it, man. I said, what kind of store is this? I said, this is a music store. I said, who else you gonna deal with unless it's a professional musician in the high school, band kids or something. So he said, oh, you got something there. So he went on…
Yeah. What was that place? It was across the street.
